episodeTitle.en: Manik Gupta (ex-CPO Uber, Google Maps) on how to build consumer apps, why it’s useful to be optimistic about technology, creating inflections in your PM career, the changing CPO role, and more
episodeTitle.zh: Manik Gupta（前优步、谷歌地图首席产品官）谈如何打造消费者应用、为何对科技保持乐观态度、在产品管理生涯中创造转折点、CPO角色的变化等

guestBioOfficial.en: Manik Gupta has led two of the most successful consumer products in history—Google Maps, where he was Director of product for the Maps team, and Uber, where he was CPO. After leaving Uber, he spent some time working on a product to help people avoid getting COVID called CVKey, and most recently he took on a role at Microsoft as Corporate Vice President leading many of their consumer efforts.
guestBioOfficial.zh: Manik Gupta曾领导过两款史上最成功的消费级产品——谷歌地图（他在该团队担任产品总监）和优步（担任首席产品官）。离开优步后，他致力于开发一款帮助人们避免感染新冠病毒的应用CVKey，最近还加入微软，担任负责多个消费者业务的企业副总裁。

title.en: Manik Gupta (ex-CPO Uber, Google Maps) on how to build consumer apps, why it’s useful to be optimistic about technology, creating inflections in your PM career, the changing CPO role, and more
title.zh: Manik Gupta（前优步、谷歌地图首席产品官）谈如何打造消费者应用、为何对科技保持乐观态度、在产品管理生涯中创造转折点、CPO角色的变化等

summary.en: Manik shares lessons on building consumer products, structuring product teams, and the difference between company-market fit and product-market fit. He reflects on what it was like to be CPO at Uber versus Google versus Microsoft. The episode also offers career advice for anyone aiming to become a CPO.
summary.zh: 马尼克分享了打造消费级产品、搭建产品团队，以及"公司-市场契合"与"产品-市场契合"之别的心得。他回顾了在 Uber、Google 与微软担任 CPO 的不同体验。本期还为有志成为 CPO 的人提供了职业建议。
